content: react-pdf on Next/Vercel (web, low confidence): serverExternalPackages ['@react-pdf/renderer'] fixes ESM/require errors (Next 16 local docs list it among auto-externalized packages already); Font.register once at module load with absolute paths built from process.cwd(); static TTF per weight (variable fonts render wrong weights); register a Unicode-capable font; ensure TTFs are traced into the function bundle via outputFileTracingIncludes keyed by route path; renderToBuffer inside a GET handler is the standard pattern.
